{{Top|leg}}
"'''Save The Hydenock'''" was a campaign started by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] conservationists on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]], the recently colonized [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], when the [[hydenock]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] threatened to become extinct. At the same time, however, [[New Otoh Gunga]] planners wanted more hydenock harvested. As a consequence, a third party was called in to lead the hydenock reforestation effort while ensuring that the Gungan colonists got the building supplies they required.

==Behind the scenes==
The "Save The Hydenock" environmental campaign was first mentioned in "Hydenock Campaign," one of the thirteen eco-challenges available in the mission mode of the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier]]''.
